posts.title: More VRAM is all that matters

slides.text: More VRAM is all that matters
THE TRUTH — Memory bandwidth, the cooler and sustained TGP matter as much as raw VRAM. A high-wattage lower-tier GPU often beats a low-power version of a higher tier.

posts.title: Set up iCloud Keychain properly

slides.text:
Set up iCloud Keychain properly
Settings > your name > iCloud > Passwords & Keychain
Settings > your name > iCloud > Passwords & Keychain
Turn on Passwords & Keychain
Add your important logins to it
Enable it on your Mac too (System Settings > Apple Account)
Autofill everywhere, one passcode to remember.
Save this — you'll need it next time.

posts.caption:
Set up iCloud Keychain properly 🍎

1. Settings > your name > iCloud > Passwords & Keychain
2. Turn on Passwords & Keychain
3. Add your important logins to it
4. Enable it on your Mac too (System Settings > Apple Account)
5. Autofill everywhere, one passcode to remember.

Save this for the next ticket →
